name: pinned-list-needle
body: The pinned-list test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.acceptance_node_edge_surface_is_transparent_and_pinned_in_help_tools_and_agents` carries a list of `(agent-name, needle)` pairs. The authoring-tool vocabulary needle `` `apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add` `` is carried by `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, and the pin entry names that file alongside that needle. The reviewer section lives in `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, and the retired-surface loop scans every embedded AGENTS entry (including `agent-builder.md`) for retired surfaces.
